latestVersion.changelog:
Weiyun skill 1.0.0 initial release:

- Provides comprehensive Weiyun (微云) cloud drive file management via MCP protocol.
- Supports directory/file listing, categorization, batch download/upload/delete, sharing, renaming, moving, and folder creation.
- File upload includes FTN protocol with Python SHA1 split hashing implementation.
- Includes version update check mechanism and detailed usage instructions for Windows and Linux.
- All main features documented in SKILL.md; local client-side hashing required for uploads.
